notes.title: Play the Suika Pets Demo Now During Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Calling all puzzle lovers and pet enthusiasts! The whimsical puzzle collection of Suika Pets is ready for you to explore—play the FREE demo now during Steam Next Fest!

Merge, match, and strategize your way to high scores by combining adorable pets (careful, don’t let them overflow!). Then, put your logic skills to the test in Suika Pet Cross, where every move counts in clever nonogram logic puzzles.

Dive into the demo to:
🐾 Grow your perfect pets to their maximum potential
🧠 Challenge your brain with two addictive game modes
🏆 Climb the leaderboard ranks and show off your skills

This limited-time demo is your chance to fall in love with the charm, chaos, and clever gameplay of Suika Pets. Ready to cuddle some critters and crush some puzzles? Play now—and don’t forget to wishlist if you’re hooked!
